# Summary

An alias for the `wtaf` skill, for users who prefer a politer name.

## Skill dependencies

- **Required:** `wtaf`
- **Optional:** None

## Workflow

### 1. Run wtaf

Invoke the `wtaf` skill with the same arguments the user gave this one, including `--fast`, `--thorough`, and any scope. When the session has no skill tool, read `wtaf`'s `SKILL.md` in the sibling `wtaf` skill directory of this plugin and follow it.
